question:
Two sides stand apart, yet students pass between🚶‍♀️🚶‍♂️
No river below, no train in sight.
Find the crossing that joins them both. 🌉🔍

Where blessings meet creativity🙏🎨
A Bhavan of patrons is your guide,
With Ganesh and art on either side. 
Find the spot connecting the two. 🔍

Shhh… quieter than an exam hall! 🤫📚
Where stories sleep, look around—
A flower that blooms forever can be found. 🌸
No soil, no rain, yet memories remain—
Find it framed, and your clue you’ll gain!

A thirsty visitor may never ask, 🐾
But someone has already done the task.
Find the little water stop for four-legged guests. 🐶💧

When hunger strikes, where do students go? 🍽️
Where plates arrive and conversations flow?
Follow the aroma, follow the crowd,
A famous name hides among the food. 
Find the place where this legend is served!

Every circle has a point where it begins.
You have travelled far enough to complete yours.
Find the point that has seen you before—
only then is your journey whole. 🔍

Where books open and minds wander,
many choose to pause without entering a classroom.
Nearby, another room keeps the news of the day,
but that is not where your journey ends.
Leave the familiar spot behind you,
and look where what is hidden lies beyond the square—
a quiet secret that points you toward where hungry footsteps gather. 🔍

Not a stage, yet performances happen here.
Not a theatre, yet spectators gather near.
They lead somewhere, but today they lead you to a clue.
Find the steps coloured with the colour of the heart. 🔍

Built before the building ever came together,
this one stands apart from the rest.
A separate group has made this block their own,
and it waits where every campus journey begins.
When you find the beginning,
look for the steps that invite you in.

I wait quietly beneath the open sky,
collecting what the clouds leave behind.
No tap feeds me,
no bucket fills me.
Find the place where rain gets a second purpose. 🔍

Where countless journeys come to rest,
look beyond the machines that brought them there.
Something above the rows quietly catches every eye, though it never moves from its place.
Where the campus comes alive between one moment and the next. 🔍

Every circle has a point where it begins.
You have travelled far enough to complete yours.
Find the point that has seen you before—
only then is your journey whole. 🔍

When the lights go out, this place becomes important.💡
You probably won’t have a class here, but the entire block depends on what’s inside.
Find the place that keeps the power running.

I am lighter than almost everything, 💧
yet I carry a symbol far heavier than myself.
Look where science meets a wheel, ☸️
and find the answer standing before a block.

Two destinations. One connecting path.🪜
One place feeds you.
Another takes you away.
Somewhere between the two,
a few steps will lead you closer.🔍

The secret of changes is to focus all of your energy, not on fighting the old, but on building the new
– Dan Millman

I have no hands, yet I command a halt. I have no voice, yet I decide your fate. Where wisdom wears a familiar face, A silent guardian stands in my place.
I do not move, yet movement ends. I do not speak, yet every journey bends. Seek the one who makes the restless still, Beneath the watch of the remover of ill.🚗

Your next destination hides where letters meet numbers. Seek the second step in the alphabet, then rise beyond the floors you have already passed. At the level that follows four, look for the place where tiny glass balls once raced across the ground.

Every circle has a point where it begins.
You have travelled far enough to complete yours.
Find the point that has seen you before—
only then is your journey whole. 🔍
